name: SM_Rubble_Pile_PR
dresses: heap of fallen masonry 2.1 x 1.2 x 0.45 m: about a dozen squared blocks and twenty-odd broken stones tumbled over a low mound of dust
material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: One review round. Blocks and stones are scattered by rule, some float a centimetre or intersect; the dust mound has a clean rim; no small debris.
